formats.key: initializeDeposit((bytes4 version, bytes inputVector, bytes outputVector, bytes4 locktime) fundingTx, (uint32 fundingOutputIndex, bytes8 blindingFactor, bytes20 walletPubKeyHash, bytes20 refundPubKeyHash, bytes4 refundLocktime, address vault) reveal, bytes32 destinationChainDepositOwner)
effects: No tokens or ETH leave the signer: the function is not payable and makes no transferFrom from msg.sender.
Reveals a Bitcoin funding transaction to the tBTC Bridge (bridge.revealDepositWithExtraData). The depositor is the L1 depositor contract and destinationChainDepositOwner is stored as extra data.

Fixes destinationChainDepositOwner (bytes32, must not be zero) as the party who later gets the minted tBTC, bridged to this contract's destination chain (Base, Arbitrum, StarkNet and so on) in finalizeDeposit.
The call reverts unless reveal.vault equals the configured tbtcVault, and it can run only once per deposit key (funding tx hash + output index).
If a reimbursement pool is attached and the signer is authorized, it records a deferred gas refund owed to the signer, paid at finalization.
formats.shown: "Initialize tBTC deposit", then raw values: funding output index, wallet and refund pubkey hashes, refund locktime as hex, the vault address, the destination owner as a raw 32-byte hex value, and the raw Bitcoin tx parts as optional fields.

findings.title: initializeDeposit shows the tBTC recipient (destinationChainDepositOwner) only as a raw 32-byte hex value.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {path: destinationChainDepositOwner, label: 'Destination owner', format: 'raw'}; case 0 screen shows '0x0000000000000000000000005c72f3cbff4a6d323b405fef09c1a0a73e61f4bc'. AbstractL1BTCDepositor.finalizeDeposit sends tBTC to this owner via _transferTbtc(tbtcAmount, destinationChainDepositOwner).
findings.fix: Label it 'tBTC recipient (destination chain)'. Where a deployment's destination is EVM, show the last 20 bytes as an address, or split the descriptor per destination chain so the field can say which chain the address is on.

findings.title: The initializeDeposit intent hides that minted tBTC is bridged to another chain for the destination owner.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json intent 'Initialize tBTC deposit', no interpolatedIntent. One descriptor covers Wormhole Base (0x186d…), Arbitrum (0x75a6…), StarkNet (0xc903…) and BTCDepositorWormhole deployments, so the screen never names the destination chain.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Reveal Bitcoin deposit; tBTC goes to {destinationChainDepositOwner} on <chain>', using a separate descriptor per destination chain.

findings.title: initializeDeposit shows the refund locktime as raw little-endian hex instead of a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json {path: reveal.refundLocktime, format: 'raw'}; case 0 screen 'Refund locktime' = '0x65f1d480'. It is a 4-byte little-endian Bitcoin timestamp (per the AbstractL1BTCDepositor.initializeDeposit natspec '<locktime> The Bitcoin script refund locktime (4-byte LE)').
findings.fix: Keep it optional or hide it. ERC-7730 cannot byte-swap, so a readable date is not possible.

findings.title: initializeDeposit cannot show the BTC amount being deposited, which sits inside the raw outputVector.
findings.evidence: The amount is the value of output reveal.fundingOutputIndex inside fundingTx.outputVector (case 0 'Bitcoin outputs' = '0x01a086010000…'). The bridge reads it as bridge.deposits(depositKey).amount in AbstractBTCDepositor._initializeDeposit.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730. Bitcoin output vectors cannot be decoded.

findings.title: initializeDeposit shows many technical Bitcoin fields that a normal signer cannot check.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json shows 'Funding output', 'Wallet pubkey hash' and 'Refund pubkey hash' raw with visible 'always', plus four optional raw fundingTx fields.
findings.fix: Make wallet pubkey hash and funding output optional. Keep the refund pubkey hash and destination owner visible.

findings.title: The only initializeDeposit test case uses synthetic data and has no mined transaction.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json minedError 'tx not found'. Its walletPubKeyHash is 0x1111…, its refundPubKeyHash is 0x2222…, and the descriptor has no other cases.
findings.fix: Add a real mined initializeDeposit transaction for each destination-chain deployment.
